Toll Free: 855-862-4441                                Email: myguitarsupply@gmail.com   View Cart Home Terms and Conditions Refund Policy Menu Home Terms and Conditions Refund Policy Categories Pickups Seymour Duncan Dirty Deeds Distortion Pedal Home SEYMOUR DUNCAN - Pickups & Amps Powerstage Amps Seymour Duncan Dirty Deeds Distortion Pedal $119.95 Seymour Duncan Dirty Deeds Distortion Pedal - 11900-001 - USE COUPON CODE MGS10 TO SAVE 10%    Unavailable Listen to the youtube video of this fine pedal here: https://www.youtube.com/watch? v=Fs9imYYEh5Q&feature=youtu.be And heres another video with this pedal; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A0-FeyUYQOU&list=PL164DE8C5F7C1022D&index=46 The Dirty Deed is a high-gain, s traight ahead rock distortion pedal that delivers classic, full sounding dis tortion to a spar - kling clean amp, or a bold, rich overdrive to an already dirty rig. The pair of MOSFET transistors evoke the tube-like harmonics and lush sustain that only come from dangerously pushed amplifiers. With the drive control turned down it works like a mean overdrive, but revel in the searing distortion and sweet overtones that the Dirty Deed dishes out when cranked. For maximum flexibility the Dirty Deed incorporates an active EQ for 12dB of treble and bass boost/cut. It will be hard going back to "tone knob". SPECIFICATIONS Distortion Circuitry: Discrete MOSFET pair Bypass: True bypass Gain Control Range: CCW: 30dB +/- 1.5dB; CW: 63dB +/- 1.5dB EQ Center Frequencies: Bass 90Hz; Treble 2.1 KHz S/N Ratio at minimum gain and maximum le vel settings: 120dB Noise referred to input, 400Hz t o 20kHz: 1uV rms THD @ 10mVrms input @ 1 KHz with 30dB of gain: 0.12% Max Output before Saturation: 2.6Vrms Input Impedance: 470K Ohms Output Impedance: 2.8K Ohms Power: 9V battery or external 9 to 18V Regulated DC Adapter (center negative) Current Consumption: 6.5 mA Max Dimensions: 2.61" x 4.90" x 1.45" Build your own web store with PrestoStore
